name: Vaultwarden
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Vaultwarden is a lightweight password manager server that works with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions. Sign-ups are off at first: turn them on to create your account, or set an admin token to invite users. The apps need HTTPS, so put it behind a proxy with a certificate.
startup: [ -n "${ADMIN_TOKEN:-}" ] || unset ADMIN_TOKEN; [ -n "${DOMAIN:-}" ] || unset DOMAIN; ROCKET_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0 ROCKET_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} DATA_FOLDER=data WEB_VAULT_FOLDER=web-vault exec ./vaultwarden

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Vaultwarden: Vaultwarden publishes no downloads besides its container
# image, so this takes the binary and the web vault out of the official
# image on ghcr.io (its Alpine build, a static binary), every layer
# checked against its SHA-256. The data folder (the vault database,
# attachments, keys) and .env are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsS --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$@"; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Vaultwarden has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

# The release, from GitHub (gh-release says why when it doesn't exist).
version=$(gh-release tag dani-garcia/vaultwarden "${VERSION:-latest}") || exit 1

if [ -x vaultwarden ] && [ -d web-vault ] && [ "$(cat .vaultwarden-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Vaultwarden $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Vaultwarden $version"
    repo=dani-garcia/vaultwarden
    reg=https://ghcr.io/v2/$repo
    token=$(get "https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:$repo:pull&service=ghcr.io" | jq -r .token) ||
        fail "ghcr.io can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    auth="Authorization: Bearer $token"
    index=$(get -H "$auth" -H "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json" "$reg/manifests/$version-alpine") ||
        fail "Vaultwarden's image for $version isn't on ghcr.io. Set Version to latest, or to another release, then reinstall."
    digest=$(jq -r --arg a "$arch" 'first(.manifests[] | select(.platform.os == "linux" and .platform.architecture == $a) | .digest) // empty' <<<"$index")
    [ -n "$digest" ] || fail "Vaultwarden $version has no image for this CPU ($arch)."
    layers=$(get -H "$auth" -H "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json" "$reg/manifests/$digest" | jq -r '.layers[].digest') ||
        fail "ghcr.io can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p $work/root
    for layer in $layers; do
        get -L -H "$auth" -o $work/layer "$reg/blobs/$layer" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "sha256:$(sha256sum $work/layer | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$layer" ] || fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        tar -xf $work/layer -C $work/root --no-same-owner
        rm -f $work/layer
    done
    [ -x $work/root/vaultwarden ] && [ -f $work/root/web-vault/index.html ] || fail "Vaultwarden's image didn't have the files it should. Reinstall to try again."
    install -m 0755 $work/root/vaultwarden vaultwarden.new
    rm -rf web-vault.old
    [ ! -d web-vault ] || mv web-vault web-vault.old
    mv $work/root/web-vault web-vault
    mv -f vaultwarden.new vaultwarden
    rm -rf web-vault.old
    echo "$version" > .vaultwarden-version
fi

mkdir -p data
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    cat > .env <<'ENV'
# Vaultwarden's settings: https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden/blob/main/.env.template
# Add settings here as NAME=value lines (SMTP for emails, for example) and
# restart. The server's settings (port, sign-ups, admin token, domain)
# win over this file, and the admin page's saved settings win over both.
ENV
fi
echo "Installed Vaultwarden $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Vaultwarden version to install, such as 1.37.5, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Allow sign-ups
variables.description: Let anyone who can reach the server create an account. Turn it on to make yours, then off again.

variables.name: Admin token
variables.description: The token for the admin page at /admin, where you invite users and change settings. Leave it empty to turn the admin page off.

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: The address people open Vaultwarden at, including https, used in emails and for passkeys.
